title: Phase 2 peer delivery: missing implementation
description:
Several Phase 2 peer delivery features were scaffolded but never implemented. Discovered during Phase 2 review.

Missing from kith-peer:
1. Attachment delivery (sending): build_peer_deliver_request does not include attachments; outbox_tick does not pass attachments
2. Attachment delivery (receiving): DeliverMessageArgs has no attachments field; DeliverHandler does not validate or store attachment metadata
3. Group chat delivery (sending): build_peer_deliver_request has no participants param; outbox_tick does not pass participants
4. Group chat delivery (receiving): DeliverHandler computes chatId from exactly 2 participants (hardcoded); no N-participant support
5. Attachment validation on receive: no validate_attachments in kith-peer

These were tracked as KITH-3yb.6/7/9 and closed without the code being written. This is a Phase 2 completion blocker.

Root cause: Beads issues were closed before implementation was verified by cargo build/test.
